thread:
carmen (CSM): heads-up — OrbitCloud onboarding hit a tail-latency bump this morning, and renewal signal is a bit soft. think proactive perf pilot could help.
neha (AM): thanks — customer is on the growth plan, renewal in 9 weeks. they’ve been sensitive to token costs.
derek (SE): saw the alert. p50 okay, but p99 spikes around 1.2s for long-context chat. looks like their traffic has more long-tail seqs than expected.
oliver (ML Eng): quick idea: pilot int8 quant + compact model for lower-cost routing on non-critical routes. could save 20–30% cost and shave median latency. want to raise a canary.
marcus (PM): caution on quality regression — we need a small eval set from their recent calls before swapping. capture a handful of failing examples.
carmen (CSM): @bryce — would you be open to a short canary (48h) that routes 15% of production reads to a compact/int8 combo? we’ll monitor quality and have rollback ready. :eyes:
bryce (OrbitCloud): sounds ok if you can show me the eval results up front. cost savings look attractive. who owns the rollout?
neha (AM): we’ll coordinate — CS + SE will run the pilot, ML will validate quality. SE will own routing config and rollback.
derek (SE): plan: create a new route policy "orbitcloud:compact_canary" that matches route=chat.read and header x-orbit-canary=1, weight=15%. also add fallback to full model on high-latency or error.
redwood-deploy-bot: deploy queued — changing route policy "orbitcloud:compact_canary" in staging.
derek (SE): sample policy (staging):
```
route_policy:
  name: orbitcloud_compact_canary
  match:
    - path: /v1/chat
      header: x-orbit-canary: "1"
  variants:
    - model: open-compact-int8
      weight: 15
    - model: open-base-fp16
      weight: 85
  fallback: open-base-fp16
  quality_checks: [perplexity-delta, rerank-f1]
```
oliver (ML Eng): for quality checks: run eval suite of ~200 recent conversations, measure top-1 semantic similarity (>0.95) and rerank F1 within 3%. I'll run local sims and post results.
marcus (PM): also capture product-level KPIs: task completion rate, user-visible latency, and NPS impact. set alerts if task completion drops >2%.
carmen (CSM): next steps: 1) derek deploys canary in staging & smoke tests 2) oliver runs eval and posts delta 3) get OrbitCloud opt-in to flip header on 15% of traffic 4) 48h observation window 5) rollback criteria defined.
derek (SE): staging smoke passed. creating canary in prod w/ weight=0 initially. will ramp header at noon PST.
redwood-deploy-bot: canary rollout started: orbitcloud_compact_canary weight=0 -> 15% over 10m.
oliver (ML Eng): initial eval: semantic-similarity mean=0.967, median latency improved -12%. top regression case count = 3/200, all low-confidence hallucination edge cases — logging examples to #eng-ml.
bryce (OrbitCloud): received eval — looks reasonable. please keep the fallback path in place. want daily summary for first 48h.
derek (SE): added fallback on any generation error or if latency > 900ms. also added a prefetched kv-cache tweak for their session patterns.
carmen (CSM): we’ll capture customer feedback each day and loop in renewals team if signal improves. good to document savings estimate for renewal playbook.
marcus (PM): can you capture before/after avg cost per 1k tokens? product needs numbers to include in the renewal deck.
oliver (ML Eng): preliminary numbers: cost per 1k tokens down ~24% on canary traffic, overall p50 down ~10%. will finalize after 48h.
derek (SE): two small regression examples flagged — I’ve routed those user sessions back to fp16 variant immediately.
bryce (OrbitCloud): appreciate the granular handling. feel free to escalate if anything looks off.
carmen (CSM): logging action items: [derek] monitor routing & rollbacks, [oliver] final eval report, [neha] prep renewal note with savings, [marcus] list KPIs and alert thresholds.
neha (AM): I’ll draft the renewal note once oliver confirms final savings. target to have a one-pager in 7 days.
redwood-deploy-bot: canary metrics: 15% traffic, error rate 0.02% (baseline 0.03%), p50 latency -11%, p99 latency -6% on canary.
oliver (ML Eng): final eval posted: semantic similarity 0.965, rerank-F1 delta -1.8%. recommend continuing to 48h full window.
carmen (CSM): thanks team. will collect OrbitCloud daily feedback and schedule a sync with Renewals if numbers hold. closing this thread after 48h window unless an incident occurs. :thumbsup:
